name: check_availability
description:
To query available appointment slots on the calendar.

CRITICAL: This tool ALWAYS returns HTTP 200. A 200 does NOT mean success — you must READ the body and act on its contents, never assume.

On SUCCESS the body is: {"ok": true, "slots": [{"day": "YYYY-MM-DD", "time": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS", "iso": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z"}, ...]}
- "time" = The value for booking.
- "iso" = Reference only, not needed.
- ONLY offer/book slots literally in the slots list.

On ERROR the body is: {"ok": false, "error": "CODE", "message": "explanation"} — please correct the call and retry:
- "no_start_time": the day argument was missing. Retry with a concrete YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "invalid_slot_target_date": the date was missformatted. Retry with a valid YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "no_availability_in_window": no free slots in that window. Check the next available day and offer its closest slots.
- "upstream_unavailable": the calendar is temporarily down. Say you'll retry shortly, then retry.
